title: Force Enemy Appear battle comand at start of battle.

posts.author: Kilitar
posts.body:
I want run "Enemy appear" battle event before player can react. I did not find way how to force it.
If I set event at turn 0 - RPG Maker MV just do it at the end of turn 0, so AFTER players.
Yep, I have few "workarounds" - like force all player actors to skip their first turn with some message "preparing for battle". Or I can even fade out screen at start of event and fade in at turn 1 so nobody notice
.
But with my OCD I prefer more direct approach if available
.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
If you don't check "Turn End" it will do it right at the start of the battle. If it doesn't, I would assume you got some issue with a plugin.
(Also your profile says MV, Your post is in MZ, but you mention MV?)

posts.author: Kilitar
posts.body:
Yep, it is MZ. (Used to work with MV for long time, I am new to MZ).
And Event start right at the turn start. But I made my troops bit modular.
I have only "8 fake placeholders" which are hidden - instead of direct troops as enemies.
At start of turn 0 I  make calculations and for example for "goblin squad" - random amount 1-8 of various types of goblins are picked and using Enemy transform command and then Enemy Appear command finally enters battle.
But - Enemy appears command make enemy visible (and targetable) AFTER player choose action with his actors. At the end of turn 0. No matter checkbox you mentioned. Everything else works before player, as expected.
I am using Visustella plugins including battle core, so maybe, but I use default front view MZ style. Visustella is for graphic items, anyway, they "might" did something about it.   - I will try it on clean project and battle test it there.
EDIT:
To be exact - they do not appear at the end of turn, just AFTER player choose 0 battle turn action - (pick targets).

posts.author: Kilitar
posts.body:
Ok, solved.
If I force "wait" action to each enemy troop they appear immediately.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Sounds like a lot of eventing for something you coulda done with a plugin, but glad you got it working.
